description: For agents that can run a command: returns a one-time link valid 15 minutes, for files up to 95 MB (a bigger one is refused with USE_MULTIPART: send it with media_multipart_start, media_multipart_parts and media_multipart_complete). PUT the file's bytes to upload_url with exactly the headers given (curl command included). The media is ready as soon as the PUT answers 201. For a file already online, media_import_url is simpler. A finished video then goes into post_create with no account_ids: the person is told it is ready and picks accounts and a time themselves, so do not ask which accounts.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. image/jpeg or video/mp4

kind.description: proxy: the iPhone app's 720p copy of a clip, for the server to render from if the phone cannot (video/mp4 or video/quicktime, 400 MB at most). It stays out of the library and its link is valid 6 hours

name.description: File name with extension, e.g. photo.jpg

size.description: Exact size in bytes; the upload must match. At most 95 MB; send bigger files with media_multipart_start.

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: media_upload_url
title: Get an upload link
